Property Management
Property Management
Our Business

Our property management services cover Hong Kong and mainland China, encompassing a diverse range of residential and commercial projects,including office buildings, large-scale shopping malls, luxury residences and large-scale residential projects,providing comprehensive and high-quality professional property management services for our customers.

In Hong Kong, many international renowned commercial buildings and key properties are managed by Kai Shing, including International Commerce Centre (ICC), sky100, Kowloon Commerce Centre, New Town Plaza, MOKO, Metroplaza, YOHO Mall, Mount Regency, Aegean Coast and Park Island etc. In addition, our subsidiary Supreme Management Services Limited offers hotel-style property management services to premium residential projects such as Park YOHO, Riva, The Vineyard, Severn 8, The Leighton Hill, Ultima and Kennedy 38.

In the early 1990s, Kai Shing started to expand its operation to mainland China, managing projects in major cities such as Shanghai, Beijing, Chengdu, Guangzhou, Shenzhen and Foshan etc. We have been providing property management service for many renowned landmarks in mainland China, including Shanghai IFC, Shanghai ICC, One ITC and Two ITC in Shanghai, Shanghai Central Plaza, Shanghai Arch, Arcadia, Todtown, Lake Genève, Parc Central, Tianhui Plaza, Nanhai Plaza, Beijing APM, New Town Plaza (Beijing), Chengdu ICD and Nanjing IFC etc, the presence of Kai Shing is successfully spanned across the entire country.

Supreme Management Services Limited (Supreme) is dedicated to providing exceptional property and facility management services for select premium residential properties. Supported by the new technologies, a series of six-star services are able to fulfil customer needs, even exceed their expectations for property and lifestyle. We provide comprehensive and proactive support to cater customer needs, and offer personalised concierge service to boost the value to customer experience.
Learn more：https://www.supreme-mgt.hk/

WeSpire Living is a new-generation brand dedicated to redefining property management. Our vision is to create a unique “Smart Living Well” concept by introducing state-of-the-art smart technologies coupled with innovative ideas. We strive to be an inspiring force and partner in life and we are committed to delivering a diverse and high-quality service experience.

Established in 1996, Shanghai Kai Shing Property Management Services Co., Ltd. (Shanghai Kai Shing) was the first company under Kai Shing to enter the property management industry in mainland China. It primarily provides property management services for projects in Shanghai and Suzhou, including landmarks such as Shanghai IFC, Shanghai ICC, One ITC and Two ITC in Shanghai, Shanghai Central Plaza, Shanghai Arch, Arcadia, Todtown and Lake Genève etc. Since its inception, Shanghai Kai Shing has been providing high standard property management services that meet international standards for world-class properties, earning itself a good reputation in mainland. The company has grown rapidly with continuous improvement in service quality.

Established in 2004, Guangzhou Kai Shing Property Management Co., Ltd. (Guangzhou Kai Shing) takes charge of projects in Guangzhou, Beijing, Nanjing, Chengdu in mainland China. These projects include Parc Central, Tianhui Plaza, Nanhai Plaza, Beijing APM, New Town Plaza in Beijing, Chengdu ICC and Nanjing IFC etc. With years of property management experience, Guangzhou Kai Shing is committed to providing high-end property management services for mainland customers. It has been actively expanding in China and successfully receiving numerous accolades over the years.
